testcase.name: Scenario: Select visible available commands with the keyboard: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1563:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select visible available commands with the keyboard ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user selects 2D Sketches in the available command list ✔ And the user presses Ctrl+A while the available command list has focus ✔ Then every currently visible available-command row is highlighted ✔ And the Part Tools target remains empty ✔ When the user clicks 3D Annotations in the available command list ✔ Then 3D Annotations is highlighted ✔ And the other currently visible available-command rows are not highlighted ✔ And the Part Tools target remains empty
